title: Characterising Toxicity in Generative Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using the Perspective API's 'Identity Attack' dimension and lexical attribution analysis (via Captum's Layered Integrated Gradients and POS tagging) to identify how nouns referencing racial groups trigger toxic model outputs.
Evaluated through the Perspective API's 'Identity Attack' scores and lexical analysis, identifying how terms referencing LGBTQ+ identities act as high-attribution triggers for toxic content.
Evaluated as a component of the Perspective API's 'Identity Attack' dimension, which flags language targeting individuals based on identities such as gender.
Identified through lexical attribution analysis highlighting how specific nouns referencing religious groups (e.g., 'catholics') trigger escalated toxicity in model responses.
